what_it_is: Disc 1, outside gongaga. cloud, aeris, and tifa in party. cloud, aeris, barret, red13, and yuffie all have limit breaks up to 3/2. around 250K gil. cloud is lvl41. no cheats used.

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: zip of 1 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); it holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASCUS-94163FF7-S02)
